summary: Innventure, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Delaware holding company (formerly Learn SPAC HoldCo, a blank-check vehicle, ticker INV), filed an 8-K reporting that David Yablunosky ceased serving as CFO, principal financial officer and principal accounting officer on October 19, 2026, and simultaneously entered a consulting agreement paying $5,500 per week through May 14, 2027, with COBRA reimbursement and continued vesting of Innventure and Refinity Holdings securities. Eric Stober is announced as incoming CFO. No board recommendation, advisor or transaction terms were disclosed. Watch for Form 10-K certification risk and new-CFO capital strategy signals.
